verdict.rationale: The a-Shell README says each window has its own context, appearance, command history and current directory. `newWindow` opens a session and `exit` closes it. Appearance is set per window via `config`, `config -p` makes those settings the default for future windows, and `.profile` runs on each new window for further customization. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-window behavior beyond first-party docs.
